description: Holds the child recordset of p1 (c1), a Clone of it (positioned on its last row) and the Tags Field2 of the parent recordset; then moves the parent MoveNext, MoveNext, MoveLast, MoveFirst and after each move records the parent's Name, then RecordCount, BOF, EOF, Bookmark and current row of c1 and of the clone, the group obtained again from the held Field2.Value (same fields), and the Name of c1.ParentRecordset.
retentionNote: Designed r-cplx-rebuild probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
